api.name: verifyAttestation
api.description: Verify a registered OpenClawd plugin's on-chain attestation via the Solana Attestation Service. Returns SAS PDA owner check, formal-verification proof_hash status, ERC-8004 registry membership, and the offchain attestation block.

identifier.description: Plugin identifier as it appears in the public plugin.delivery index (e.g. "clawd-attestation", "coingecko").

meta.title: Clawd Attestation
meta.description: Verify on-chain attestations for OpenClawd plugins
